title: Lambda-CDM (Dark Energy)
description: Our universe: 30% matter, 70% dark energy (Omega_Lambda = 0.7). Seeded early (z ~ 9) so the cosmic web forms during the matter era, then dark energy takes over (a > 0.75) and freezes structure growth. The web stops evolving while space keeps expanding. D(a)^2 plateaus around 8x instead of running away (validated against linear theory).
